note: Controlled vocabulary for data/agent-watch.json (2026-09-22). Every keyed record renders its en/zh text from here, so a translation is written once and cannot drift per record; scripts/test-agent-watch.mjs asserts that rendered text equals this table. Keys are stable identifiers, never shown to readers.

agent.lede_en: Libraries you import to build an agent: orchestration, tool calling, memory, structured output and interoperability protocols.
agent.lede_zh: 写代码时引入的库：编排、工具调用、记忆、结构化输出与互操作协议。

coding.lede_en: Agents that write, edit, review or ship code — in the terminal, the IDE, the browser or as a hosted engineer.
coding.lede_zh: 替你写代码、改代码、审代码或直接交付的智能体：终端、IDE、浏览器或托管工程师形态。

mcp.zh: MCP 服务器、客户端与注册表
mcp.lede_en: Model Context Protocol pieces: servers that give any agent a new ability, clients and gateways that host them, SDKs and directories.
mcp.lede_zh: 模型上下文协议的各个部件：给任意智能体加能力的服务器、承载它们的客户端与网关、SDK 与目录。

automation.lede_en: Trigger-action and scheduled workflows with AI steps, from open-source builders to hosted agents.
automation.lede_zh: 带 AI 步骤的触发式与定时工作流，从开源搭建器到托管智能体。

platform.lede_en: Places where you assemble or simply use agents: self-hosted studios, desktop clients, cloud consoles and hosted general-purpose agents.
platform.lede_zh: 搭建或直接使用智能体的地方：自托管工作台、桌面客户端、云控制台与托管的通用智能体。

browser.zh: 浏览器与电脑操作智能体
browser.lede_en: Agents that drive a browser or a whole desktop, plus the crawling and headless-browser layers underneath them.
browser.lede_zh: 操作浏览器或整台电脑的智能体，以及它们下面的抓取与无头浏览器层。

voice.lede_en: Realtime speech agents for phone and web: open-source frameworks and hosted voice APIs.
voice.lede_zh: 面向电话与网页的实时语音智能体：开源框架与托管语音 API。

observability.lede_en: How you know an agent works: tracing, evaluation suites, red-teaming scanners and runtime guardrails.
observability.lede_zh: 怎么知道智能体是否可靠：追踪、评测套件、红队扫描器与运行时护栏。

memory.lede_en: Long-term memory layers and knowledge graphs that let an agent remember across sessions.
memory.lede_zh: 让智能体跨会话记住事情的长期记忆层与知识图谱。

runtime.lede_en: Where agent code actually runs: sandboxes for untrusted code, model gateways and managed agent runtimes.
runtime.lede_zh: 智能体代码真正运行的地方：不可信代码的沙箱、模型网关与托管运行时。

research.lede_en: Deep-research agents, paper assistants and natural-language data analysis.
research.lede_zh: 深度研究智能体、论文助手与自然语言数据分析。

trade.lede_en: Agents built for import, export and purchasing teams.
trade.lede_zh: 面向进出口与采购团队的智能体。

web3.lede_en: Agent tooling that touches wallets and chains. Listed for completeness; nothing here is a recommendation.
web3.lede_zh: 涉及钱包与链的智能体工具。仅作收录，不构成任何推荐。

developers.lede_en: You write code and want a framework, SDK, memory layer, runtime or evaluation tool to build on.
developers.lede_zh: 你自己写代码，需要一个框架、SDK、记忆层、运行时或评测工具来搭。

coders.zh: 让 AI 替你写代码的人
coders.lede_en: You want an agent that writes, edits, reviews or ships code — pick by where you work: terminal, IDE, browser or a hosted engineer.
coders.lede_zh: 你想要一个替你写、改、审或交付代码的智能体，按你工作的地方选：终端、IDE、浏览器或托管工程师。

no-code.lede_en: Hosted products, desktop clients and visual builders you can use without programming.
no-code.lede_zh: 无需编程就能用的托管产品、桌面客户端与可视化搭建器。

mcp.zh: 给任意 Agent 加能力（MCP）
mcp.lede_en: MCP servers, clients, gateways and registries — attach them to Claude, Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI or your own agent.
mcp.lede_zh: MCP 服务器、客户端、网关与注册表，挂到 Claude、Cursor、Cline、Gemini CLI 或你自己的智能体上。

teams.lede_en: Hosted platforms a company buys: customer-service agents, enterprise integrations and cloud agent services.
teams.lede_zh: 由公司采购的托管平台：客服智能体、企业系统集成与云端智能体服务。

research.lede_en: Deep research, paper reading, data analysis and the evaluation tools that measure agents.
research.lede_zh: 深度研究、读论文、数据分析，以及衡量智能体表现的评测工具。

mcp-stdio-or-remote.zh: MCP 服务器（本地或远程）

cloud-service.en: Cloud service with console and API

open-source.en: Open-source; model usage billed by your own provider
open-source.zh: 开源；模型用量按你自己的供应商计费

open-source-cloud.en: Open-source self-hosting; hosted plans priced on the official site
open-source-cloud.zh: 开源可自托管；托管方案以官网定价为准

free-tier.en: Free tier; paid plans priced on the official site
free-tier.zh: 有免费档；付费套餐以官网为准

paid.en: Paid product; pricing on the official site
paid.zh: 付费产品；定价以官网为准

free-registry.zh: 免费公开注册表 / 目录

byok.en: Free client; bring your own model API key
byok.zh: 客户端免费；自带模型 API key

included-with-platform.en: Included with the vendor's platform; platform pricing applies
included-with-platform.zh: 随厂商平台提供；按平台定价计费

usage-billed.en: Usage-billed cloud service; rates on the official site
usage-billed.zh: 按用量计费的云服务；费率以官网为准

unstated.en: Pricing not stated on the checked page

repo-only.en: public repository is the official page
